description: Source code for the Zephyr RTOS CDC ACM USB device class driver, implementing USB serial communication over CDC ACM protocol with functions for handling USB requests, data transfer, and UART-like control.

methods.name: cdc_acm_init
methods.description: Initializes the CDC ACM device, sets up work queues, and registers device in the system.

methods.name: cdc_acm_fifo_fill
methods.description: Fills the transmit ring buffer with data to send over USB.

methods.name: cdc_acm_fifo_read
methods.description: Reads data from the receive ring buffer.

methods.name: cdc_acm_class_handle_req
methods.description: Handles class-specific USB requests such as setting line coding and control line states.

methods.name: cdc_acm_dte_rate_callback_set
methods.description: Sets a callback for DTE rate changes, if supported.
